library(SBC)

```{r cluster, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
setup_cluster(max_server_workers = 100, max_local_workers = 10)
```


```{r}
one_sim_generator <- function(N, P, rho = 0, shape1 = 1, shape2 = 1) {
  beta <- rnorm(P, 0, 1)
  prob <- rbeta(1, shape1, shape2)
  m <- rbinom(P, size = 1, prob = prob)
  betaMod <- beta * m
  
  cor_m <- matrix(rho, nrow = P, ncol = P)
  diag(cor_m) <- 1
  X <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(N,sigma = cor_m)
  X[,1] <- 1
  
  mu <- X %*% betaMod
  
  sd <- rexp(1)
  
  y <- rnorm(N, mu, sd)

  list(
    variables = list(beta = beta, m = m, sd = sd, prob = prob),
    generated = list(X = X, n = N, p = P, y = y, shape1 = shape1, shape2 = shape2),
    var_attributes = var_attributes(m = c(binary_var_attribute(), possibly_constant_var_attribute()))
  )
}

dq <- derived_quantities(
  model_index = as.numeric(paste0("0.", paste0(m, collapse = ""))),
  graded_model_index = as.numeric(paste0(sum(m), ".", paste0(m, collapse = ""))),
  betaShift = dplyr::if_else(m == 1, beta, -10),
  .var_attributes = var_attributes(model_index = possibly_constant_var_attribute(), graded_model_index = possibly_constant_var_attribute(), betaShift = possibly_constant_var_attribute())
)

rho <- 0.8
shape1 <- 1
shape2 <- 1
param_cache_text <- paste0(if_else(rho == 0, "", paste0("_rho_", rho)), "_sh_", shape1, "_", shape2)
```

```{r}
backend_rjags_with_top <- function(...) {
  res <- SBC_backend_rjags(...)
  class(res) <- c("my_top_model", class(res))
  res
}

SBC_fit.my_top_model <- function(...) {
  res <- NextMethod()
  class(res) <- c(class(res), "my_top_model_fit")
  res
}

SBC_fit_specific_dquants.my_top_model_fit <- function(fit) {
  # Working with string representation of the models as I may need over 100bits of information so ints/doubles are not enough
  samples_matrix <- as.matrix(fit$samples)
  model_samples_matrix <- samples_matrix[, grepl("^m\\[[0-9]*\\]$", colnames(samples_matrix))]
  full_model_samples <-apply(model_samples_matrix, MARGIN = 1, FUN = paste0, collapse = "")
  full_model_table <- table(full_model_samples)

  max_entry_id <- which.max(full_model_table)
  max_model_string <- names(full_model_table)[max_entry_id]
  max_model_vector <- stringr::str_split_1(max_model_string, pattern = "")

  dq_string <- paste0("m[", 1:length(max_model_vector), "] == ", max_model_vector, collapse = " && ")
  do.call(derived_quantities, list(top_model = rlang::parse_quo(dq_string, rlang::current_env()),
                     .var_attributes = var_attributes(top_model = c(possibly_constant_var_attribute(), binary_var_attribute()))))
}

my_globals <- c("SBC_fit_specific_dquants.my_top_model_fit", "SBC_fit.my_top_model")
```


```{r}
backend_small <- backend_rjags_with_top("linear-selection.jags", n.iter = 20000, n.burnin = 5000, n.chains = 4, thin = 10, variable.names = c("beta", "m", "sd", "prob"))

```


```{r}
set.seed(655223142)
ds_small <- generate_datasets(SBC_generator_function(one_sim_generator, N = 50, P = 2, rho = rho, shape1 = shape1, shape2 = shape2, future.chunk.size = Inf), n_sims = 10000)
```


```{r small}

res_small <- compute_SBC(ds_small, backend_small, 
                         keep_fits = FALSE,
                         dquants = dq,
                         globals = my_globals,
                         cache_mode = "results",
                         cache_location = file.path(cache_dir, paste0("SBC_linear_rjags_small_N", length(ds_small), param_cache_text, ".rds")))
```

```{r}
plot_ecdf_diff(res_small)

bp_small <- binary_probabilities_from_stats_empirical(res_small$stats)


metrics_small <- SBCBayesFactors:::calibration_metrics_per_variable(bp_small)
purrr::iwalk(metrics_small, \(metrics, name) {cat("\n=====", name, "====\n"); print(metrics)})
```



```{r}
backend_large <- backend_rjags_with_top("linear-selection.jags", n.iter = 
                                     400000, n.burnin = 50000, n.chains = 4, thin = 100, variable.names = c("beta", "m", "sd", "prob"))
```

```{r}
set.seed(2465223)
ds_large <- generate_datasets(SBC_generator_function(one_sim_generator, N = 80, P = 100, rho = rho, shape1 = shape1, shape2 = shape2, future.chunk.size = Inf), n_sims = 500)
```

```{r large-all}
res_large_all <- compute_SBC_cache_blocks(ds_large, backend_large, 
                         keep_fits = FALSE,
                         dquants = dq,
                         cache_prefix = file.path(cache_dir, paste0("SBC_linear_rjags_large", param_cache_text,"_")),
                         block_size = 100)

```

```{r}
res_large <- res_large_all[res_large_all$default_diagnostics$max_rhat < 1.01 & res_large_all$default_diagnostics$min_ess_to_rank >= 0.5]
```

```{r}
plot_ecdf_diff(res_large, combine_variables = combine_array_elements)

bp_large <- binary_probabilities_from_stats_empirical(res_large$stats)


metrics_large <- SBCBayesFactors:::calibration_metrics_per_variable(bp_large, include_reliability_diag = FALSE, prob1_prior_base = "avg_true")
metrics_large_df <- purrr::map_dfr(metrics_large, calibration_metrics_to_df)

metrics_large_df |> summarise(
  min_DAP_p = min(DAP_p),
  DAP_rejection = mean(DAP_p < 0.05),
  min_miscalibration_p = min(miscalibration_p),
  miscalibration_rejection = mean(miscalibration_p < 0.05),
  min_log_gamma_m_threshold = min(log_gamma - log_gamma_limit),
  log_gamma_rejection = mean(log_gamma < log_gamma_limit)
)
```

```{r}
hist(res_large_all$stats |> filter(variable == "graded_model_index") |> pull(simulated_value) / 1e100, breaks = seq(0, 101, by = 1))
bp_large |> filter(grepl("m\\[[0-9]\\]", variable)) |> plot_binary_calibration()
hist(bp_large$prob)
min(p.adjust(metrics_large_df$miscalibration_p, method = "holm"))
min(p.adjust(metrics_large_df$DAP_p, method = "holm"))
hist(metrics_large_df$DAP_p)
```

# Distribution of number of samples belonging to the top model

res_large_test$fits |> purrr::map_int(\(fit) {
full_model_samples <- as.matrix(fit$samples)[, paste0("m[", 1:100, "]")] |> apply(MARGIN = 1, FUN = paste0, collapse = "")
max(table(full_model_samples))})
